description: A master services agreement between two invented companies, written as a Word document with python-docx: Heading 1 and clause paragraphs linked to one automatic multi-level list (1., 1.1), three footnotes, a running header, a "Page X of Y" footer, bold defined terms, and a Schedule 1 rate table with a repeating header row that runs over two pages. Calibri and Cambria are substituted by the metric-compatible Carlito and Caladea. The PDFs were rendered by LibreOffice 24.2 from the Office files (headless --convert-to pdf), not by Microsoft Office. Edits from the discussion draft to the signature draft: the subcontracting sub-clause moved from clause 7 to the end of clause 3; a cyber insurance sub-clause added to clause 4; the monthly charge raised; the index cap in footnote 2 lowered; the exclusion of indirect loss in clause 8.3 made bold; the sentence on deleting personal data removed from clause 9.2; the court seat changed; a row A17 added to Schedule 1; the first-hour call-out rate raised; and the running header changed from the discussion draft to the signature draft. Consequences that are not listed: the automatic clause numbers change (moved clause 7.2 becomes 3.4, clauses 4.3 and 4.4 become 4.4 and 4.5), the body re-flows across pages 1 to 3, and in Schedule 1 the rows from A17 on shift so that row B20 moves to page 5 under the repeated header row. The header change appears on every page.
